kind: 40 fixed validation articles; frozen Medium settings; NOT final test or factuality certification

rouge_definition.aggregation: mean per-article F1, scaled 0-100; failed jobs score zero; successful-only means also reported
rouge_definition.rougeL: flat sequence LCS, newlines ignored; NOT rougeLsum

sample_policy: Rows 2-41 inclusive, selected before generation. Rows 0/1 and Jensen input excluded. Consecutive fixed sample, not random or population-representative.
human_review: No human ratings collected; numerical metrics and software checks are not factuality evidence.

reference_audit.sensitivity_label: Post-hoc descriptive sensitivity, NOT a replacement primary sample. Template-page references may reward boilerplate unrelated to episode events; memorization or dataset leakage is not established.

uncertainty_note: Bootstrap intervals describe resampling variation within these 40 consecutive articles. They are not population-representative confidence or factuality estimates. Paired differences reuse the same article indices. All runs used Medium; no length-setting comparison was performed.

environment.timing: Synchronized existing backend generation regions; no repeated latency benchmark or explicit warmup. First inference includes first-use kernels; model load/transfer reported separately.

settings_note: Per-call model_generation_kwargs are actual explicit overrides. HF calls inherit checkpoint configuration above; max_new_tokens overrides max_length and min_new_tokens overrides min_length. forced_eos_token_id is explicitly disabled. OpenNMT settings are recorded per call. Token counts use each backend's tokenizer, including source specials where applicable.
